jobs.occupation: Compliance Officer Awareness und Prevention (m/w/d) - Essen (GER) or Madrid (SP) (Compliance-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Company

Through its Rothe Erde, Uhde and Polysius businesses as well as the majority investment thyssenkrupp nucera, Decarbon Technologies delivers innovative, cutting-edge technologies for the transition to a climate-neutral industrial economy. Rothe Erde is a leading provider of bearings and solutions that play a key role in wind, solar and tidal power plants, among other things. With its solutions for decarbonization, defossilization and the circular economy, Uhde is a technology and implementation provider of large-scale plants for the chemical industry. Polysius supplies green technologies for the cement and lime industry, digital automation solutions, and on-site and remote maintenance services. thyssenkrupp nucera is a global supplier of electrolysis technology for the industrial-scale production of clean hydrogen. The segment employs around 12,000 people, who generated revenues of approximately 3.8 billion euros in fiscal year 2023/2024.

Your responsibilities

- You will actively contribute to the further development and effective implementation of the Compliance Management System within the Decarbon Technologies segment and take ownership of selected compliance areas, including anti-corruption, data compliance, anti-money laundering, and export control/trade compliance. A key focus of your role will be the provision of antitrust and competition law advice as well as the further development and implementation of competition law compliance measures.
- You will help ensure that segment-wide standards are adhered to, compliance risks are identified at an early stage, and regulatory requirements are implemented efficiently across the organization.
- As part of a holistic compliance approach, you will advise and support the business on additional compliance topics, particularly with regard to the German Supply Chain Due Diligence Act (LkSG) and related regulatory requirements.
- You will advise the companies within the thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies segment on a broad range of compliance matters. This includes, among other things, providing antitrust and competition law advice in MundA projects, addressing liability-related questions arising from the application of the Compliance Program, and supporting the coordination and enablement of Compliance Officers in the Business Units and regions. In doing so, you will contribute to the effective and consistent implementation of compliance requirements throughout the segment.
- You will support compliance reporting at segment and Group level, assist in the development of compliance processes, policies, concepts, and preventive measures, and accompany their implementation in an international environment.
- You will monitor and analyze regulatory developments and compliance risks, derive appropriate measures, and support their implementation.
- In addition, you will independently manage cross-functional compliance projects and actively drive the further development of the compliance organization and compliance culture within the segment.

Your profile

- You are passionate about working collaboratively and excited to contribute to the further evolution of Compliance at thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies during a period of transformation and growth.
- You hold an degree in Law and have successfully completed the Second German State Examination (Second State Exam) or possess an equivalent legal qualification. Additional qualifications, such as an LL.M. or other postgraduate degree, are considered an asset.
- You bring significant and recent experience in a senior compliance role within an international corporation or complex business environment. You have a proven track record of not only advising on compliance matters, but also shaping, implementing, and continuously improving compliance programs and governance frameworks.
- You have extensive expertise in the design, implementation, and enhancement of Compliance Management Systems (CMS).
- You have substantial experience advising on competition and antitrust law matters in an international business context, including cooperation agreements, distribution structures, public tenders, and MundA transactions.
- Your expertise covers key compliance areas, including competition law, anti-corruption, data protection and digital regulation, anti-money laundering, and trade compliance.
- You combine strong legal and regulatory knowledge with a pragmatic, business-oriented approach and the ability to translate complex requirements into practical solutions.
- You are an effective communicator with strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trust and credibility across all levels of the organization.
- You thrive in an international and cross-cultural environment and distinguish yourself through integrity, discretion, resilience, and a high level of personal accountability.
- You have successfully led complex, cross-functional, and international projects and are comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
- You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. German and Spanisch language skills are highly desirable.

Your benefits

At thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies, we are committed to providing an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. Our benefits include:

- The opportunity to make a meaningful impact by contributing to the continued growth and success of thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies in a dynamic and future-oriented industry.
- A competitive compensation package combined with attractive benefits.
- Flexible working hours, hybrid and mobile working arrangements, and the opportunity, subject to agreement, to work remotely from within the European Union for up to 20 days per year.
- A wide range of health and wellbeing initiatives, including confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services, preventive healthcare offerings through our occupational health service (such as health screenings and seasonal vaccinations), and various sports and wellness programs.
- Extensive professional and personal development opportunities through a broad portfolio of training programs, learning initiatives, and career opportunities across the thyssenkrupp Group.
- A structured and personalized onboarding program designed to help you settle in quickly and build a strong network from day one.

Contact

thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies GmbH
Sofie Putschke
Human Resources

We value diversity

We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

jobs.occupation: Process Engineer – Advanced Materials (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Chemietechnik)
jobs.description:
Key Facts at a glance:

- In your role as Process Engineer (all genders), you will be responsible for operating an AIXTRON CCS or Planetary system in our application laboratory.
- You will serve as the direct contact for the Simulation and Design departments regarding process
optimization and further development of reactor hardware.
- In addition, you will work closely with colleagues from Sales & Marketing and conduct system
demonstrations to support customer acquisition. You will also contribute to cooperation projects with internal and external partners.

In Detail

- As a process engineer in the AIXTRON application laboratory, you will actively and independently shape the development and optimization of our deposition reactors and processes for compound semiconductor deposition.
- Thanks to your independent and well-coordinated working style, you will plan and manage cross-departmental projects to further develop our deposition processes and drive the evaluation of hardware prototypes.
- Your fascination with technology and your pursuit of perfection will motivate you to design and coordinate sometimes complex test series within development projects.
- Turning data into information: With your structured and scientific-analytical approach, you will recognize complex relationships and draw conclusions from experimental series.
- As a multiplier of our know-how, you will carefully analyze and document the knowledge and experience gained and share it with colleagues and team members.
- You will be able to adapt processes developed in the laboratory to customer requirements and transfer them to customer systems, making a key contribution to ensuring our customers’ rapid success.

Your Profile

- You hold a degree in a scientific or technical field, e.g., Physics, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a comparable qualification.
- During your studies and professional experience, you have developed solid expertise in CMOS technology, advanced material deposition, semiconductor processing, and solid-state physics. In addition, you possess in-depth knowledge of epitaxial growth processes for both Group III–V and Group IV materials, which you confidently apply in practice.
- You have process experience in semiconductor deposition, ideally using RPCVD on a commercial epitaxy system. Knowledge of other growth techniques such as MBE, ALD, or sputtering is also advantageous.
- You are experienced in handling various characterization methods and solid-state physics-related questions and have worked with measurement equipment.
- You have good written and spoken English skills.
- You are flexible and open to international travel (approximately 5–10%).

What you can expect from us

- Flexible working hours: No fixed core hours, mobile working options, and the ability to switch between office and mobile office.
- Vacation: 30 vacation days as standard, with the option to increase annually through salary conversion.
- Profit sharing: Opportunity to participate in the company’s success and benefit from profit sharing.
- Health: Promotion of your physical and mental health through regular health initiatives.
- Further development: Continuous development through the AIXTRON Academy and individual support programs.
- Retirement and additional insurance: Support for pension plans, capital-forming benefits, and additional insurance options.
- Catering: Subsidized meals in the company cafeteria and fresh seasonal fruit baskets.
- Open corporate culture: Open and respectful informal culture (“Duz”) across all hierarchy levels.
- Sustainability and mobility: E-charging stations for cars and bicycles, good public transport connections, and free parking.
- Employee referral program: Attractive rewards for referring new talent to AIXTRON.

Job DescriptionBuild our warehouse and logistics operations with us!

CS-International is a fast-growing international company operating in the trading card game, collectibles, gaming and entertainment industries.As our business continues to grow, we are building and professionalizing our warehouse and logistics operations in Ratingen. We are therefore looking for a hands-on Junior Warehouse & Logistics Manager who wants to take real ownership, develop scalable processes and grow into a future leadership position.This is not a purely administrative role. You will work directly within the operation, help establish our systems and processes from scratch and gradually take over responsibility for the entire warehouse and logistics function.

Your responsibilities
• Support the setup and continuous development of our warehouse and logistics operations in our brand new warehouse in Ratingen
• Help design efficient processes for inbound goods, storage, picking, packing, shipping and returns
• Actively participate in day-to-day warehouse operations, particularly during the setup phase and peak periods
• Support the implementation and configuration of our new ERP and warehouse management processes
• Translate operational requirements into practical ERP workflows together with management, internal teams and external implementation partners
• Establish clear processes for inventory management, stock accuracy, cycle counts and annual stocktaking
• Help define warehouse layouts, storage locations, product flows and picking structures
• Coordinate parcel and freight shipments as well as relationships with carriers and logistics service providers
• Monitor operational performance and develop relevant KPIs and reports
• Identify bottlenecks, errors and inefficient processes and implement practical improvements
• Create and maintain process documentation, work instructions and operational standards
• Gradually coordinate and lead warehouse employees and temporary staff
• Support logistics planning for events, conventions, retail activities and international projects
• Work closely with Events/Organized Play, Project Management and Management
• Take on increasing responsibility with the long-term perspective of leading our warehouse and logistics department
• Grow gradually into this role, having the opportunity to become part of our management

Qualifications
• Completed vocational training or a degree in logistics, supply chain management, business administration or a comparable field
• Approximately two to three years of relevant professional experience in warehousing, logistics, fulfilment or supply chain operations
• Practical understanding of inbound goods, storage, inventory management, picking, packing, shipping and returns
• Confident use of Microsoft Office applications and general familiarity with digital business systems
• Very good written and spoken German and good written and spoken English (Our main language is ENGLISH!)

Experience with ERP or warehouse management systems, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Shopify, shipping software, international logistics or the coordination of operational teams would be an advantage, but is not essential.

Your Profile
• You have a hands-on mentality and are willing to actively support day-to-day warehouse operations
• You enjoy building new processes, systems and structures rather than simply maintaining established routines
• You work in a structured, accurate and independent manner and take ownership of your responsibilities
• You are able to identify operational problems and develop practical, workable solutions
• You communicate reliably and enjoy working across departments and with external service providers
• You are motivated to support the implementation of a new ERP and warehouse management structure, you are a stakeholder in this process
• You are comfortable working in a growing environment where processes are still being developed
• You have the ambition to gradually take on leadership responsibility and develop into the future head of our warehouse and logistics operations

You do not need to already have experience in every individual area. What matters most to us is your understanding of warehouse operations, your willingness to actively build new structures and your motivation to grow into a responsible leadership position. We want to help you developing with workshops etc. in areas you are not 100% confident.
What to expect
• A key role in building and professionalising our warehouse and logistics operations from the ground up
• The opportunity to actively shape workflows, warehouse structures and operational standards
• Direct involvement in the implementation of our new ERP and warehouse management processes
• A varied position combining hands-on warehouse operations, process development and project work
• A high level of ownership and the freedom to contribute and implement your own ideas
• Close cooperation with management and the opportunity to get involved into the gaming industry
• Short decision-making paths and an international working environment
• Diverse products and projects from the trading card game, collectibles, gaming and entertainment industries

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a "Gas Turbine R&D – Project Engineer" you are a committed, independent and creative personality with knowledge of gas turbines and basic knowledge of project management. As a member of the Gas Turbine Engineering Project Management Office Team, you will support global project management in the planning, implementation and controlling of R&D projects / programs. In addition to classic project management tools, you will also apply modern agile methods such as SCRUM for the cooperation of the development teams.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Fostering the standard execution schedule as a knowledge base for other parties supporting time scheduling in Large Gas Turbine R&D projects
* You establish and coordinate overview of budget, milestones and resource plans to facilitate regular monitoring
* Facilitate execution through coordination across multiple functions including engineering, business controlling, supply management, manufacturing development and other interfaces as required
* Furthermore, you support project/program portfolio planning, prioritization and resource allocation
* You facilitate regular program reviews, support resolution of resource, budget or schedule conflicts as needed
* You facilitate project stand up meetings / SCRUM meetings

What You Bring

* Successfully completed Master’s degree in a technical or business-related field
* Proven professional experience in relevant areas such as gas or steam turbines, project management, and project controlling is desirable
* Proficient in standard software (MS Office); experience with project management tools (e.g., MS Project) and project scheduling is an advantage
* Technical product knowledge in the field of large gas turbines (e.g., SGT5-4000F, SGT5/6-2000E or comparable LGT frames) is desirable but not mandatory
* Business-fluent German and English, both written and spoken, as well as intercultural competence
* Strong teamwork and communication skills, decision-making ability, problem-solving competence, assertiveness, and a clear sense of goals complete your profile

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs
